note: Profil BTC: te same reguły co XAUUSD (wszystkie progi względne – ATR, ticki, liczba świec), skopiowane jako HIPOTEZA badawcza – nie dostrojone ani nie zwalidowane dla BTC. Rozmiar kontraktu, tick i prowizja pochodzą ze specyfikacji symbolu/eksportu. Zmiana dowolnej wartości = nowe profile_id. Every number is a starting research hypothesis, tuned (if at all) only in development. Changing any value = new profile id. 1.1.0: przełączniki wariantów (filtry jakości, sesja, trend, wejście limit, BE po TP1, wyjście czasowe, filtr modelu B) – domyślnie jak 1.0.0; warianty porównuje replay (config/scalp_variants_v1.json).

tick_volume_ratio_min.unit: tv / median(tv of previous 20 closed M1)

chase_limit_atr_m5.unit: x ATR14(M5) at arm, min 2 ticks

min_sweep_depth_atr_m5.unit: x ATR14(M5) at arm beyond Z_low-eps / Z_high+eps (0 = off)

retest_close_max_atr_m1.unit: max distance of the retest close beyond the zone edge, x ATR14(M1) (null = off)

slope_atr_per_bar.unit: |BB basis slope| / ATR per bar on M30 and M15

bandwidth_percentile.unit: percentile of own BandWidth over previous 100 bars

mode.unit: BOTH (M30 and M15 strong against) | ANY (M30 or M15) | ANY_PLUS_H1 (M30, M15 or H1)

tp1_fraction.unit: of volume (only if lot step allows; else single TP1 exit)

be_after_tp1.unit: NONE | COST_ADJUSTED (SL to entry + round-trip costs after TP1)

early_exit_m1.unit: closed M1 after fill without progress -> exit at close (null = off)

early_exit_min_mfe_r.unit: required MFE in R before early_exit_m1 bars, else exit

min_weighted_net_rr.unit: net reward units per unit of full risk (geometry filter, not expectancy)

exit_confirm_m1.unit: consecutive M1 in base direction + edge reclaim

bollinger.std: population (divide by N, as MT5 iBands)

mode.unit: MARKET (first fresh quote) | LIMIT_EDGE (limit at zone edge +/- eps)

limit_wait_m1.unit: M1 bars a LIMIT_EDGE order waits before MISSED

allowed_utc_hours.unit: list of UTC hours allowed for new entries (null = all)

block_after_open_min.unit: minutes after the London / New York session open without new entries (IANA DST)

enabled.unit: bool - gate READY_SHADOW on the setup-quality model (task B)

threshold.unit: P(TP1 before SL) threshold chosen in development by expectancy after costs
